title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. catalanica
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. catalanica, commonly known as the bluebell of Spain, is a subspecies of the Campanula rotundifolia plant, which belongs to the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. catalanica include wound healing, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
